name: MVP pipeline (capseq): CapSeq (RNA): culture -> cell prep -> encapsulation -> load, lysis, wash, reverse transcription (one trap) -> sublibrary PCR -> release and cleanup -> SPRI and QC (off-chip) (+ barcoding and hairpin placeholders)
description: One winner per job, all on the 30 x 20 mm, 0.3 mm deep, single-layer envelope (resin print + hot emboss, blocks from contracts/blocks.json). Culture: module1_v1. Cell prep: cell_prep_v1. Encapsulation: spc_demo_v1 (0.2 mm orifice, so capsules of about 260 um, not 135 um; curing off-chip). Load, lysis, wash, reverse transcription: module3_v1_translated, steps 1-9 of protocols/module3_v1.json. Split-and-pool barcoding is dropped and there is no separate barcoding or RT module: RT is one isothermal hold (42 C, plain poly(dT)) inside module3's capsule trap, so module3 hands capsules straight to Module 4. Module 4 and Module 5 are built. SPRI size selection and QC (Qubit, TapeStation, qPCR) are off-chip and have no protocol yet. Retired, kept for reference only: cad/m1_culture_spec.json, cad/m1b_cellprep_spec.json, cad/m3_wash_spec.json (all marked superseded in their module block), cad/m2_encapsulation_spec.json (cannot make capsules at this scale; still marked draft, not superseded), stage A of chip/sctip_spc_v1.json, and dissociation inside module1 (steps 175-178 of protocols/module1_v1.json duplicate cell_prep_v1). Not in the chain: chip/ipsc_to_mgl_chip_v1.json is a separate experiment. Retention features cannot be printed at this floor, so capsule retention needs a bought mesh insert or sedimentation. One TBC remains: Module 4 has no capsule outlet port, so the Module 4 side of module4_to_module5 cannot be named. Map and open joins: protocols/pipeline_status.md. CAPSEQ VARIANT: split-and-pool barcoding (BC2, BC3) and the hairpin ligation with its pooled wash sit between the capsule trap and the sublibrary split as PLACEHOLDERS (no chip): MJ dropped them in fcc6ef2, so the cells keep only their per-lane barcode and the data is lane-level; they come back only if the team wants single-cell resolution (protocols/pipeline_status.md).

modules.name: Module 1: culture (v1)

build.method: resin print + hot emboss, 30 x 20 mm, 0.3 mm deep, one fluidic layer
build.ports: >= 0.8 mm drilled holes at >= 5 mm pitch, <= 6 per chip

modules.note: Rescaled from 140 x 75 mm. Its own dissociation (steps 175-178) duplicates cell_prep_v1 and is still in the protocol; the back-flush, pooling and release (179-182) are still the only way cells leave. The dye-demo doc (cad/module1_dye_demo.md) predates the rescale.

modules.name: Cell prep: detach, quench, count (v1)

build.method: resin print + hot emboss, 30 x 20 mm, 0.3 mm deep, one fluidic layer
build.ports: >= 0.8 mm drilled holes at >= 5 mm pitch, <= 6 per chip

modules.note: Wins over m1b_cellprep_v1 (retired). Wash, clump filter and concentrate stay in a bench tube with a bought mesh.

modules.name: Module 2: encapsulation (spc_demo_v1)

build.method: resin print + hot emboss, 30 x 20 mm, 0.15 mm deep, one fluidic layer; curing off-chip
build.ports: >= 0.8 mm drilled holes at >= 5 mm pitch, <= 6 per chip

modules.note: The only fabricable encapsulation chip. Wins over m2_encapsulation_v1 and sctip_spc_v1 stage A (both retired). Orifice is below the 0.2 mm floor, so expect about 260 um capsules.

modules.name: Module 3: load, lysis, wash, reverse transcription, release (capsule trap)

build.method: resin print + hot emboss, 30 x 20 mm, 0.3 mm deep, one fluidic layer; retention gap cannot be printed, so a bought mesh insert
build.ports: >= 0.8 mm drilled holes at >= 5 mm pitch, <= 6 per chip

modules.note: The one capsule trap, and the one place RT runs (steps 5-7: RT mix, 42 C hold, wash; no barcode or UMI added, cells already carry a per-lane barcode). Wins over m2_trap_1 and m3_wash_v1 (retired). Her file is the source of truth. Built for 70 um capsules and a 650,000 count; encapsulation makes about 260 um capsules.

modules.name: Barcoding: split and pool (BC2, BC3)
modules.status_note: placeholder · dropped by MJ for now
modules.note: Placeholder. MJ dropped split-and-pool barcoding (fcc6ef2): the cells keep only the per-lane barcode they get in Module 1, so the data is lane-level, not single-cell. This stage comes back only if the team decides single-cell resolution is needed (open question in protocols/pipeline_status.md).

modules.name: Hairpin ligation + pooled wash
modules.note: Placeholder: the hairpin ligation after the last barcode round and the wash of the pooled capsules. Dropped together with split-and-pool barcoding (fcc6ef2).

modules.name: Module 4: sublibrary split + index PCR

build.method: hot-embossed COC (Tg >= 130 C), thermally bonded; 0.5 / 0.3 / 1.0 mm
build.ports: >= 0.8 mm drilled holes at >= 5 mm pitch, <= 6 per chip

modules.note: Filled one chamber at a time by an off-chip rotary valve (palindromic order), then thermocycled.

modules.name: Module 5: release + cleanup

build.method: hot-embossed COC (Tg >= 130 C), thermally bonded; 0.5 / 0.3 / 1.0 mm
build.ports: >= 0.8 mm drilled holes at >= 5 mm pitch, <= 6 per chip

modules.note: Collagenase release at 37 C, then magnetic bead capture; one sublibrary per pass.

to.note: cell_prep_v1 has no dedicated cell inlet; cells enter cult_1 through in_buffer.

handoffs.note: One counted suspension leaves j_mid through p_mid. Module 1 steps 175-178 already lift and quench the cells, but cell_prep_v1 steps 1-3 expect an adherent layer in cult_1 and dissociate again, so the join does not match.
By tube: one spin, a bought mesh and resuspension in the viscous buffer happen at the bench between the two chips.

Capsules are collected and cured off-chip in a tube, then loaded through Module 3's pre-filter into main_trap. Undocumented: breaking the emulsion and washing off the oil. Size does not match: about 260 um capsules against a 70 um design and a 100 um pre-filter gap.

connector.warning: Barcoding is a placeholder: no chip, so no port style yet.

handoffs.note: Washed capsules (after RT in the trap) into the split tree.
Pooled capsules after the last barcode round.

to.note: Through an off-chip rotary valve, one chamber at a time, in the order A B C D D C B A, twice.

connector.warning: The hairpin step is a placeholder; Module 4 takes 0.8 mm drilled ports. The rotary valve sits between them, so this is tubing either way.

handoffs.note: RT already ran inside Module 3's trap, so the RT-treated, resuspended bed leaves in one counted suspension (76.9 uL after step 9). Module 4 draws only 16 x 0.6 uL = 9.6 uL of it, so a concentration step is undocumented. The tubing and valve are not on either chip.

from.note: Module 4 has no capsule outlet: in_s1-in_s4 are inlets and p_vent is an outlet that capsules cannot pass. The sublibrary has to leave back through its own in_sN, or Module 4 needs an outlet port; neither is written down.

handoffs.note: One sublibrary per pass, by tubing between the chips (Module 5 protocol steps 1, 9, 17, 25). The TBC is real: the chip has no outlet to name.
Four libraries into tubes; pooling, SPRI size selection and QC are at the bench (Module 5 steps 33-34).
